snapshot.reason: The company secured a Rs 29.13 Crore purchase order from Northern Railway, providing a direct, verifiable boost to near-term revenue.
snapshot.why_now: The order was announced via exchange filing on October 16, 2026.
source_headlines: Magellanic Cloud Limited: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 16, 2026, titled "Magellanic Cloud Limited's Wholly Owned Subsidiary Provigil Surveillance Limited, Receives Purchase Order for an order worth Rs 29.13 Crore from Northern Railway Moradabad Division".
